records.question: Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50. Moses will take 40% of the total amount while Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves. How much more than Esther will Moses get?
records.response:
Moses will take 40/100*$50 = $20
The remainder is $50 - $20 = $30
Tony and Esther will split $30 equally, so each will get $30/2 = $15
Moses will get $20 - $15 = $5 more than Esther.

records.question: Karen bakes 50 chocolate chip cookies. She keeps 10 for herself, and she gives 8 to her grandparents. If Karen wants to give everyone in her class cookies, and there are 16 people in her class, how many cookies will each person receive?
records.response:
Karen keeps 10 cookies for herself and gives 8 to her grandparents, so she has 50 - 10 - 8 = 32 cookies left.
She wants to give these cookies to 16 people in her class, so each person will receive 32 / 16 = 2 cookies.
